description: highly detailed crisp pixel art scene, fine pixel detail: a small mysterious figure in a dark navy hooded cloak, its face a glowing ice-blue light, glowing ice-blue hands, seen from the side facing right, standing at a big black cauldron hanging over a low fire in an old village kitchen and stirring the soup with a long wooden ladle, steam rising, a wooden table with vegetables and a fish beside it, strings of onions and garlic hanging from the beams, warm firelight, the whole figure and the cauldron inside the frame

references.usage: the same small hooded figure: its dark navy cloak, its glowing ice-blue face and hands, its size in the frame and the fine pixel style; only the work and the place are new
